patches_added.name: Fix server error after idle
patches_added.description: Retries a request with a fresh login when the old one has expired, instead of showing "kesalahan server" on the first open after a long break.

patches_modified.name: Always show navigation bar
patches_modified.description: Adds an option in Fakh Patches to keep the navigation bar on screen while you scroll.

patches_modified.name: Anonymous profile viewing
patches_modified.description: Adds an option (off by default) to visit profiles without being listed in "Who viewed your profile": the app does not report the visit.

patches_modified.name: Copy text
patches_modified.description: Press and hold a post, comment or any other text to open it in a sheet where it can be selected and copied.

patches_modified.name: Disable analytics
patches_modified.description: Adds an option (off by default) to stop sending most LinkedIn analytics events.

patches_modified.name: Disable double-tap like
patches_modified.description: Stops double tapping a post or photo from liking it.

patches_modified.name: Download media
patches_modified.description: Adds a download button to the full screen photo and video viewer.

patches_modified.name: Expand posts
patches_modified.description: Adds an option in Fakh Patches (off by default) to show posts expanded by default. Tapping the text collapses them.

patches_modified.name: Feed filters

patches_modified.name: Glass navigation bar
patches_modified.description: Draws the navigation bar as a floating, translucent capsule with a sliding selection pill. Slide a finger along it to switch tabs. Liquid Glass blurs what's behind it.

patches_modified.name: GmsCore support
